candidates.title: Naidu Warns Rebels Of Suspension If They Contest Against Official Candidates
candidates.excerpt: TDP president and CM N. Chandrababu Naidu warned that party members who contest against official candidates in the local body polls would be suspended from the party.

candidates.title: Rafales, Sukhois, Tejas over the Ganga: IAF gears up for grand aerial display in Varanasi
candidates.excerpt: Varanasi will host the Indian Air Force's ‘Wings Over Ganges’ aerial display on October 25, 2023. This event will feature fighter aircraft, helicopters, and aerobatic teams performing over the Ganga. The display is part of the service’s 94th anniversary celebrations and will include nine formations. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is expected to attend the aerial show. Rehearsals have already been conducted in Varanasi in preparation for the main event.

candidates.title: Neha Bora moves Delhi HC against notice issued under BNSS Section 126
candidates.excerpt: The Delhi High Court will hear AISA president Neha Bora’s plea on October 22 challenging a police notice requiring her to execute a peace bond. Bora alleges the notice is vague and seeks protection against coercive action by police

candidates.title: Man finds black rubber piece in juice bottle, wins Rs 22,340 from consumer court
candidates.excerpt: A consumer based in Haryana discovered a troubling foreign object—a black rubber piece—inside a Fresca Litchi Drink bottle. This alarming find prompted the individual to seek compensation, leading the district consumer commission to investigate. Tests confirmed the drink was unsafe due to the contaminant. Consequently, Fresca Foods was deemed liable for the quality concerns raised and was ordered to compensate the consumer with Rs 22,340.

candidates.title: ‘Get your facts straight’: BJP accuses Rahul Gandhi of hypocrisy over RSS remarks on women’s rights
candidates.excerpt: Bharatiya Janata Party officials criticized Congress leader Rahul Gandhi for his recent statements about the RSS. They accused him of hypocrisy regarding women's respect based on his behavior towards women. BJP spokesperson CR Kesavan emphasized Gandhi's failure to address allegations against a Congress MP involved in harassment. Additionally, BJP MLA Ram Kadam challenged Gandhi's understanding of the RSS's women's wing.

candidates.title: After HM visit CBI team begins investigations into killing of anti-drug activist, CBI registers FIR
candidates.excerpt: A team from the Central Bureau of Investigations arrived in Mansa to investigate the murder of Parwinder Singh Jhota. The investigation was prompted by demands from Jhota's father and a local action committee for justice. Union Home Minister Amit Shah visited the bereaved family and assured them of justice before the CBI's arrival. The CBI is expected to collect evidence pertinent to the case and conduct a thorough investigation.

candidates.title: France arrests man, calls in anti-terror police over town hall protest fire
candidates.excerpt: Anti-terror police have been called in to investigate the suspected arson of the town hall in the central city of Limoges, a listed building dating back to 1883 whose roof and belfry collapsed when it was engulfed by fire on October 17
